method: Image generation edits to source artwork, followed by uniform whole-canvas normalization to1024x1024 preserving alpha. No manual source painting.
purpose: Correct ambiguous grip geometry in book and donut while preserving their original designs and all inspiration definitions.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production transparent PNG layer for the existing Potato-Me avatar builder. Image 1 is the existing book-and-potato-arm asset, the edit target and exact material/lighting reference. Correct its ambiguous grasp. Preserve the detailed warm russet potato skin, fine pores and freckles, rounded sculptural 3D appearance, no human fingernails, dark navy-blue cloth hardcover, cream pages, and soft upper-left lighting.

Render ONE anatomically coherent right arm of a front-facing potato character, located on the VIEWER'S LEFT. The invisible body is to the RIGHT of this isolated asset: the short arm must enter from the RIGHT, extend gently down-left, and end in a palm-up hand UNDER the open book. The book is open toward the unseen reader/body; the viewer sees its blue outer covers and spine, with cream pages visible at the top. Make the physical support unmistakable: the book's lower spine and cover rest on the palm; four rounded fingers curl under and around the lower outer cover; the ONE opposable thumb steadies the inside/page edge on the opposite side, partly occluded naturally by the book. Show convincing contact shadows, a continuous wrist and short forearm. Do not draw five parallel digits pasted on the same cover face, a floating book, a detached wrist, an extra hand, or a backwards wrist. Five digits in the hand's anatomy (one thumb plus four fingers); naturally hidden digits can be hidden.

Use a 1024x1024 transparent canvas with most of it EMPTY, matching this layered asset pack. Place all the arm+hand+book in the lower-left region, approximately x=50..390 and y=500..750. The shoulder/root is the rightmost end near x=365,y=610; the supporting palm is near x=210,y=695; book centered near x=170,y=605. Keep the entire book and all arm edges inside the canvas. This is an isolated part, NOT a whole character. No potato body, face, legs, text, letters, logo, background, floor, or ground shadow. Genuine transparent alpha outside the single arm+hand+book.
prompts.decision: Revised again: a tan shape at the page gutter read as an implausibly long thumb.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the current transparent Potato-Me book-and-arm asset candidate. Make ONE narrow correction: remove the small tan potato-colored nub peeking out of the TOP CENTER page gutter, around x=239..263,y=696..730 in this 1254 px reference. Reconstruct the cream paper/page edges there naturally. The thumb belongs behind the LOWER far cover and should be completely occluded, not reach the top of this tall book. Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE: the four visible curled fingers around the bottom near cover, the palm supporting the lower spine, continuous wrist and forearm entering from the right, all book geometry and navy cloth texture, cream pages, exact warm russet skin style/freckles, upper-left lighting, object placement, scale, and fully transparent background. Do not add digits, alter the grip, mirror the image, add a body, crop, zoom, add text or a backdrop. Same transparent canvas and composition.
prompts.decision: Accepted: palm supports the lower spine and four fingers curl over the lower cover; thumb is naturally occluded.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent production PNG layer for Potato-Me. Image 1 is the existing donut-and-potato-arm asset and exact style/composition reference. Preserve the upright pink-frosted ring donut, multicolor sprinkles, missing bite at upper right, bread texture, warm russet potato pores/freckles, soft upper-left lighting and the short bent arm entering from the right. Correct ONLY the grasp so it unmistakably pinches and supports the donut instead of laying every digit across the same front surface. Keep the wrist continuous and naturally aligned. Put one rounded opposable THUMB against the FRONT lower-right rim of the donut. Curl the index and middle fingers BEHIND the lower rim, with an index fingertip visible just inside the lower part of the central hole to show depth and an actual opposed grip. The ring and little fingers curl naturally below/behind the donut into the palm; some may be occluded, but the hand has exactly one thumb and four fingers. Include subtle contact shadows at the thumb, hole and under-edge; no floating gap, no fingers through the bread, no disconnected fingers, no backwards palm, no extra hand, no human fingernails. The invisible potato body is to the right; this is its right hand on the viewer's left.
Keep the existing asset framing: 1024x1024 transparent canvas, most of it empty, the single donut/arm entirely in approximately x=60..435,y=400..790, rightmost shoulder root near x=400,y=665. No potato body/head/face/legs, text, logos, floor, ground shadow or backdrop. Genuine transparent alpha. Match the existing render style rather than redesigning the donut.
prompts.decision: Accepted: opposed front thumb and fingers behind the lower rim, with an index pad visible inside the hole.
